--White-2 is another paint style named White (#FFF); --White is not used here: they are two styles, keep each where the layer names it.
#FFF is written raw 4 times (background of 1:3, background of 1:7, background of 2:3) and equals --White-2: use the token.
#F00 is written raw 4 times (background of 1:4, border of 1:7, background of 2:4) and equals --Accent: use the token.
4 layers keep Figma's default names (1:2 "Frame 12", 1:4 "Rectangle 7", 2:2 "Frame 12", …): name the elements by their role in the code.

2 frames have no auto layout, so their children are placed absolutely (1:2 "Frame 12" with 2 children, Figma reads it as display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 10px 0 0 10px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; 2:2 "Frame 12" with 2 children, Figma reads it as display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 10px 0 0 10px; align-items: center; gap: 8px): build them as a flow if they are meant to resize.
2 rectangles cover their parents under the content (1:3 "Backdrop" covers 1:2 "Frame 12"; 2:3 "Backdrop" covers 2:2 "Frame 12"): write each as its parent's background, not as an element.
2 frames only wrap one layer (1:5 "Wrapper" only wraps 1:6; 2:5 "Wrapper" only wraps 2:6): they may not need elements of their own.

line-height normal is Figma's Auto line height: the font's own spacing, about 1.2× the font size for most fonts (1:6 "Note"; I1:9;2:1 "Label"; 2:6 "Note"; and 1 more); give it in px where the build must match to the pixel (inspect shows each text's).

is a line break inside a paragraph (Shift+Enter in Figma,
in HTML), not spaces (1:6 "Note"; 2:6 "Note").

2 layers have strokes centred on their edges (1:7 "Card"; 2:7 "Card"): Figma paints half of it outside the box, a CSS border all inside; where it must match to the pixel, use an outline with outline-offset of minus half its width.
2 frames were detached from a component (1:8 "Detached card"; 2:8 "Detached card"): check whether the component fits instead.

2 layers are wider or taller than the room their auto layout parent gives them, so they overflow it in Figma too (1:8 "Detached card" 500px wide in 400px; 2:8 "Detached card" 500px wide in 400px): decide whether the build wraps, clips or lets them out.

2 layers inside instances differ from their component outside its properties (I1:9;2:1 "Label": color; I2:9;2:1 "Label": color): give the component a property or a variant for them, or build them as one-offs.
Fonts missing on this machine (Inter) in I1:9;2:1 "Label", I2:9;2:1 "Label": Figma could not lay these texts out, so their sizes may be off.
gap 16px on 2 layers (1:10 "Stack"; 2:10 "Stack") matches --space-16, Figma's own match for that field: use the token.
